title: Batches stop waiting for a macOS runner
why: Retrospective CI audit 14:12 CST Nov 12: batch 103 waited 26.4 min for macOS, the largest single cost, while 50 draft runs of lane-touched tests took the slots (13:30-14:40 UTC).
note: R55 express (owner 14:05 CST Nov 12). Waits on owner items 639 (drafts skip macOS while a batch runs) and 640 (his MacBook runs batch macOS jobs).
